authoritativeSource.publisher: Indian Sign Language Research and Training Centre (ISLRTC), Department of Empowerment of Persons with Disabilities (DEPwD), Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment, Government of India, New Delhi
authoritativeSource.sourceVerificationFinding: Textual citation exists in ISLRTC dictionary index, but raw reference video, landmark coordinate stream, and official frame-by-frame data have NOT been downloaded or locally verified in this repository. Sourcing from third-party YouTube videos is prohibited under LEGAL-01.

motionDescription.sourceText: Open flat hand raised to temple/chest, gentle outward forward arc

phonologicalParameters.handshape: Open flat B-hand or 5-hand (fingers extended together or relaxed)
phonologicalParameters.orientation: Palm facing forward or slightly contralateral; fingertips pointing upward
phonologicalParameters.movement: Gentle outward forward arc / salutation wave
phonologicalParameters.nonManualMarkers: Pleasant facial expression, direct eye contact with addressee

motionDescription.regionalVariations: Urban ISL communities (Delhi, Mumbai, Bengaluru) exhibit slight variations in starting height (temple vs. mid-chest) and single vs. double arc wave. Formal greeting in traditional Indian contexts frequently defaults to NAMASTE (Anjali Mudra).

blockingReasons: No official raw ISLRTC video or landmark dataset for 'Hello' is stored or licensed locally in the workspace.
No verified 3D motion-capture or keyframe animation asset exists.
Generating guessed or synthetic keyframes violates PRD non-hallucination principles.
Zero certified Deaf-native human panel reviews have evaluated this sign.
